tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind panels. The board everything is patched into.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Floating layers (menus, tooltips, dialogs, drawers), the sidebar, and table row hover. Bays sit directly on bg, unboxed.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, table header rows, empty-state wells inside a surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: table rules, chart gridlines, range tracks. Never a box around a widget.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The 2px rule across the top of every bay (widget). Titles sit on it. The only heavy line in the product.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, KPI values, body copy on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, axis text, timestamps on bg and surface (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: The brand accent. Primary actions, active nav, links, focus ring, the selected series. Never decorative.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active filter chips, hover on nav items. Text on it is ink or cobalt.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cobalt fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset, on every focusable element. ≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Brand second hue: annotations on charts (alert thresholds, 'you are here' markers) and the cover. Not a status color, not for text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Metric moving the good way (▲ ROAS, ▼ CPA). Always paired with an arrow and sign.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive delta pill or 'Synced' chip; text on it is positive.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Metric moving the bad way, failed sync, destructive actions. Always paired with an arrow, sign or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a negative delta pill or 'Sync failed' chip; text on it is negative.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Stale data, expiring tokens, partial loads. Text on surface and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a 'Stale' chip or a widget warning banner.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs. Drawers use no scrim so the board stays readable beside them.

tokens.name: ch-1
tokens.usage: Channel series 1. Channels are assigned in the order a workspace connected them, never by the vendor's own brand color.

tokens.name: ch-2
tokens.usage: Channel series 2.

tokens.name: ch-3
tokens.usage: Channel series 3.

tokens.name: ch-4
tokens.usage: Channel series 4.

tokens.name: ch-5
tokens.usage: Channel series 5.

tokens.name: ch-6
tokens.usage: Channel series 6. Past six channels, group the rest as 'Other' in ink-muted.

tokens.name: ch-other
tokens.usage: Series for channels past the sixth, grouped as 'Other'.

tokens.name: seq-0
tokens.usage: Heat grid: lowest bucket, also 'no data' with a hatch.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Heat grid bucket 2.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Heat grid bucket 3.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Heat grid bucket 4.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Heat grid: highest bucket. Sequential scales are one hue (cobalt) stepping in lightness, never a rainbow.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The headline number of a Readout. Units and cents drop to 60% size in ink-muted.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page name in the top bar.

styles.name: bay-title
styles.usage: Widget title, set on the rail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Google Ads last synced 4 minutes ago.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Only admins can change workspace settings.
styles.usage: Helper and error text under fields, toast detail, dense table cells.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Key labels, row names, channel names in direct chart labels.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Operator tags: bay labels, channel codes, status words, axis labels. Uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, deltas, tooltips, ledger values. Tabular, right-aligned in columns.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group, chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap between filter chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside a bay between rail and content; gap between Readouts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and login padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keys, inputs, toggles, bar ends. COR is square-shouldered; nothing is pill-shaped.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, tooltips, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, radio buttons and chart dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, the widget being dragged. Panels on the page get a line border, never a shadow.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the shell and controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact keys and fields inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default key, field, select and token input height.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target below 768px.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Table and list row minimum height.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width on desktop.

tokens.name: drawer
tokens.usage: Drill-down drawer width.

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Default dialog width; 640px for the report composer.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: UI icons. 20px in the sidebar and empty states.

zIndex.note: Stacking order. Nothing else sets z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the top bar.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: A bay being dragged in layout edit mode.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drill-down drawer.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and the date picker, including those opened inside a dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, always on top.
